channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: Data centers might break the grid? Good — something needs to
item.description: As AI data centers strain the U.S. power grid, one writer argues the real problem is our dependence on centralized utilities — and that Tom Cotton’s DATA Act could help shift the U.S. toward decentralized, local power generation.

item.title: Resisting ICE isn’t just about immigration
item.description: From the death of a woman in Minnesota to federal immigration raids in North Carolina, resistance is an awful reminder of a society once governed by slavery.

item.title: Drone case pits new technology against old government rules
item.description: North Carolina drone entrepreneur's fight over aerial mapping rules could push the Supreme Court to clarify how far states can use licensing laws to restrict tech-driven speech and work.

item.title: Continuing the work of Gov. Jim Hunt
item.description: After saying goodbye to “forever governor” Jim Hunt, Rep. Dante Pittman reflects on Hunt’s legacy in education and economic development and renews his call for bipartisan work on North Carolina’s budget and future.

item.title: Breakfast Optimists support Shop with a Cop
item.description: The Wilson Breakfast Optimist Club donated $500 to the Wilson Law Enforcement Fellowship to support the Wilson Police Department’s Shop with a Cop program.

item.title: Suspect charged with shooting man, dog
item.description: Boyfriend of victim's daughter charged in Wilson County home invasion that left a man shot multiple times and family dog dead; deputies still seek second suspect.

item.title: State elections board delays Knight’s appeal hearing
item.description: The North Carolina State Board of Elections has delayed Wilson County sheriff hopeful Bobby Knight’s appeal of his disqualification. Board members will meet virtually sometime in the near future to discuss the matter. That meeting has not been scheduled yet.

item.title: Wilson County commissioners honor retirees
item.description: Wilson County commissioners showed their appreciation for 20 retirees with a combined 431 years of service to the county and heard a clean 2025 audit report at their Monday night meeting.

item.title: School board seeks estimates for bus garage repair
item.description: The Wilson County Board of Education seeks cost comparisons to rebuild or renovate its fire-damaged bus garage. The board also advanced a $42 million state-funded plan to construct the new Wells-Hearne Elementary School.

item.title: Lead Brain Injury Case Manager
item.description: Neuro Community Care, LLC seeks Lead Brain Injury Case Manager in Wake Forest, NC. Provide consults for clients with brain injuries, neurological conditions, and cognitive/physical challenges. Send resume to sfriedman@neurocc.com.
